notes.title: Signup for Yuri's Resolve Close Alpha
notes.content:
[h1]Closed Alpha[/h1]

[b]Yuri’s Resolve is entering closed alpha.[/b] Most major features are in place, but large portions of the game remain untested. You’ll encounter bugs and progression blockers. That said, the first 20 hours—what we define as the end of early game—have been thoroughly play-tested. Many mid-game systems are functional, but haven’t been tested in a full 0-to-mid-game run.

If exploring wreckage, mining debris, manufacturing refineries and helping shape the future of the game sounds exciting, request an alpha key and join us in orbit.
